capabilities: Sync the vault to a GitHub repository in one action (stage, commit, fetch, merge, push)
Run sync automatically on a configurable interval
Resolve merge conflicts by keeping the local file and saving the remote version as a conflict copy
View last sync time and recent commit history in a modal
Add ignore rules written into the vault .gitignore
extras: The GitHub token is stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault; the README warns to keep the vault and backups private. Installation via BRAT or manual download is also documented.
motivation: The author built it for people who want their vault backed by a GitHub repository for backup, cross-device sharing, and version history, without installing Git on each device.
problem: Vault sync through Git normally requires installing and operating the Git CLI on every device, and Obsidian's own sync is a separate paid service.

relations.evidence: It uses isomorphic-git for repository operations and Obsidian-friendly HTTP requests
Sync your Obsidian vault directly with a GitHub repository on desktop and mobile

requires.name: GitHub personal access token (classic, repo scope)
GitHub account with a repository for the vault

summary: Git-based vault sync that stages, commits, fetches, merges and pushes an Obsidian vault to a GitHub repository on desktop and mobile without the Git CLI.
